command: bash -c SUB=$(az account show --query id -o tsv) && TOKEN=$(az account get-access-token --query accessToken -o tsv) && until [ "$(curl -s "https://management.azure.com/subscriptions/$SUB/resourceGroups/rezolve-AI/providers/Microsoft.MachineLearningServices/workspaces/brainpowa-northeurope/computes/LLM-T1-NC80?api-version=2023-04-01" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); p=d.get(\"properties\",{}); print(p.get(\"provisioningState\",\"unknown\"))")" != "Updating" ]; do echo "Still updating..."; sleep 15; done; curl -s "https://management.azure.com/subscriptions/$SUB/resourceGroups/rezolve-AI/providers/Microsoft.MachineLearningServices/workspaces/brainpowa-northeurope/computes/LLM-T1-NC80?api-version=2023-04-01" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); p=d.get(\"properties\",{}); print(\"Final:\", p.get(\"state\"), p.get(\"provisioningState\"))"
